images.description:
Stalls displaying woven wares such as kawm (Hmong woven baskets) at Hmongtown Marketplace, East Building.
 This photo depicts the "B" area of the Hmongtown Marketplace East Building, with stalls B1–B51. Most prominent are stalls B1–B14 grouped in the middle of the space, which primarily sell woven baskets (kawm) and traditional Hmong tools. The sides of stalls B14 and B1 are most visible in this photo.
 
The photographer stands at the top of the East Building stairs, facing north.  Behind the photographer is the colliqually named "main entry hallway".
images.title: File:Hmongtown Marketplace East Building weaving booth.jpg
